business_summary: Shandong Hi-speed Company Limited engages in the investment and operation of transportation infrastructure in China. The company operates and manages road and bridge assets. It is also involved in reconstruction and expansion of bridges, underpasses, grade-separated interchanges, overpasses, culverts, service areas, parking area, and toll stations, as well as expressway. The company was formerly known as Shandong Expressway Company Limited and changed its name to Shandong Hi-speed Company Limited in April 2012. Shandong Hi-speed Company Limited was founded in 1999 and is headquartered in Jinan, China. Shandong Hi-speed Company Limited is a subsidiary of Shandong High-Speed Group Co., Ltd.
business_summary_ko: Shandong Hi-Speed ​​Company Limited는 중국 내 교통 인프라 투자 및 운영에 종사하고 있습니다. 회사는 도로 및 교량 자산을 운영하고 관리합니다. 또한 교량, 지하도, 입체교차로, 고가도로, 배수로, 휴게소, 주차장, 유료소, 고속도로 등의 재건축 및 확장 작업에도 참여합니다. 이 회사는 이전에 Shandong Expressway Company Limited로 알려져 있었으며 2012년 4월에 Shandong Hi-speed Company Limited로 이름을 변경했습니다. Shandong Hi-speed Company Limited는 1999년에 설립되었으며 중국 지난에 본사를 두고 있습니다. Shandong Hi-Speed ​​Company Limited는 Shandong High-Speed ​​Group Co., Ltd.의 자회사입니다.
